name: yaps-text-to-speech
description: Turn text into spoken audio, narration, or a voice-over with Yaps.

interface.longDescription: Turn text or a text file into spoken audio, narration, or a voice-over with the local voices supplied by Yaps desktop. Pick the voice engine that matches the language of the text, including a multilingual voice for languages other than English, protect existing outputs, and save the generated WAV or PCM file.
defaultPrompt: Turn this text into a WAV file with Yaps.
Create narration from this text file.
Generate a voice-over from this script.
